title: CARBOGEN AMCIS Shanghai Site achieves successful outcome in Unannounced NMPA GMP Inspection
llm_note: The CARBOGEN AMCIS Shanghai site successfully passed an unannounced NMPA GMP inspection.

title: Avalo shares spike on skin drug data; BioNTech to cut staff
llm_note: BioNTech announced plans to close multiple manufacturing plants.

title: Lilly to invest $4.5B more into massive Indiana manufacturing complex
llm_note: Eli Lilly is investing $4.5 billion to upgrade two manufacturing facilities in Lebanon, Indiana.

title: Novelty Nobility Expands AGC Biologics Deal to Take Product Candidate Through GMP Manufacturing
llm_note: Novelty Nobility contracted AGC Biologics for GMP manufacturing of a bispecific antibody at the Chiba, Japan facility.

title: Lilly plans new $4.5B manufacturing investment in Indiana
llm_note: Eli Lilly is investing $4.5 billion to build new manufacturing facilities in Indiana.

title: Lonza looks to ride ADC wave with upcoming factory, workforce expansion
llm_note: Lonza is opening a new manufacturing site for antibody-drug conjugates and expanding its workforce.

title: FDA rolls out 1-day assessment pilot in bid to refocus inspection resources
llm_note: The FDA is implementing a new pilot program for one-day inspectional assessments at manufacturing sites.

title: Researchers’ Spinout Focuses on Simplifying Viral Vector Purification
llm_note: ChromaGenix has launched commercial peptide ligand technology for the purification of viral vectors.

title: Light-Controlled Gene Expression Platform Reportedly Doubles Standard Fed-Batch Manufacturing Performance
llm_note: Prolific Machines achieved a 21 g/L yield in a CHO-based fed-batch manufacturing run for a monoclonal antibody.

title: Elaaj Bio advances gene therapy for CDKL5 deﬁciency disorder
llm_note: Elaaj Bio partnered with CDMO Viralgen Vector Core SL to advance a gene therapy manufacturing program.
